CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT id, timezone, deleted_at FROM irrigation_zones WHERE id = ?

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT id, timezone, deleted_at FROM irrigation_zones WHERE id = ?

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

SELECT deveui,name FROM devices WHERE deveui IN (SELECT et0_station_id FROM zone_daily_agronomy WHERE zone_id=1 AND date >= '2026-10-19' AND date <= '2026-10-25')

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT id, timezone, deleted_at FROM irrigation_zones WHERE id = ?

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

SELECT deveui,name FROM devices WHERE deveui IN (SELECT et0_station_id FROM zone_daily_agronomy WHERE zone_id=1 AND date >= '2026-10-19' AND date <= '2026-10-25')

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT id, timezone, deleted_at FROM irrigation_zones WHERE id = ?
SELECT rainfall_mm, rain_source, rain_coverage, rain_selected_deveui, rain_policy_version, rain_quality_reasons, rain_received_mm FROM zone_daily_environment WHERE zone_id = ? AND date = ?

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

SELECT date,rainfall_mm,flow_liters,rain_source,rain_coverage,rain_policy_version,rain_received_mm FROM zone_daily_environment WHERE zone_id=1 AND date >= '2026-10-19' AND date <= '2026-10-25' ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT date,et0_mm,et0_source,et0_tier,et0_station_id,kc,kc_source,crop_type,phenological_stage,stage_overrun,etc_mm,hours_present,expected_hours,null_reason FROM zone_daily_agronomy WHERE zone_id=1 AND date >= '2026-10-19' AND date <= '2026-10-25'
SELECT deveui,name FROM devices WHERE deveui IN (SELECT et0_station_id FROM zone_daily_agronomy WHERE zone_id=1 AND date >= '2026-10-19' AND date <= '2026-10-25')

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN latitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC
SELECT deveui FROM weather_station_zones WHERE zone_id=1
SELECT payload_json,source,observed_at,fetched_at,expires_at FROM zone_weather_cache WHERE zone_id=1 AND cache_key='online_current_v2' LIMIT 1

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT id, timezone, deleted_at FROM irrigation_zones WHERE id = ?

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN latitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN longitude REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN phenological_stage TEXT DEFAULT 'default'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN gateway_device_eui TEXT
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN area_m2 REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN irrigation_efficiency_pct REAL
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN scheduling_mode TEXT DEFAULT 'local'
ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME
ALTER TABLE devices ADD COLUMN deleted_at DATETIME

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_shared_environment(zone_uuid TEXT PRIMARY KEY,zone_id INTEGER,gateway_device_eui TEXT,summary_json TEXT NOT NULL,shared_generated_at TEXT,shared_observed_at TEXT,last_received_at TEXT NOT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_zone_id ON zone_shared_environment(zone_id)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_zone_shared_environment_received_at ON zone_shared_environment(last_received_at)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gateway_locations(gateway_device_eui TEXT PRIMARY KEY,latitude REAL,longitude REAL,altitude_m REAL,accuracy_m REAL,hdop REAL,satellites INTEGER,fix_mode INTEGER,status TEXT DEFAULT 'no_fix',source TEXT DEFAULT 'gpsd',native_concentratord_status TEXT,chirpstack_mirror_status TEXT,last_fix_at TEXT,last_good_fix_at TEXT,sync_version INTEGER DEFAULT 0,updated_at TEXT)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS zone_weather_cache(zone_id INTEGER NOT NULL,cache_key TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT,payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,observed_at TEXT,fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(zone_id,cache_key),FOREIGN KEY(zone_id) REFERENCES irrigation_zones(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS valve_actuation_expectations(expectation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device_eui TEXT NOT NULL,zone_id INTEGER,command_id TEXT,effect_key TEXT,commanded_at TEXT NOT NULL,commanded_duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL,expected_close_at TEXT NOT NULL,flow_rate_lpm REAL,flow_rate_source TEXT,estimated_gross_liters REAL,volume_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',observed_open_at TEXT,observed_close_at TEXT,reconciliation_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING_OBSERVATION',cancel_reason TEXT,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')))

SELECT iz.id,iz.name,iz.zone_uuid,iz.timezone,iz.latitude,iz.longitude,iz.gateway_device_eui,iz.phenological_stage,iz.stage_started_on,iz.crop_type,iz.area_m2,iz.irrigation_efficiency_pct,COALESCE(iz.scheduling_mode,'local') AS scheduling_mode,(SELECT trigger_metric FROM irrigation_schedules WHERE irrigation_zone_id = iz.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS schedule_trigger_metric,gl.latitude AS gateway_latitude,gl.longitude AS gateway_longitude FROM irrigation_zones iz LEFT JOIN gateway_locations gl ON gl.gateway_device_eui = iz.gateway_device_eui WHERE iz.id=1 AND iz.user_id=1 AND iz.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT d.deveui,d.name,d.type_id,d.rain_gauge_enabled,d.flow_meter_enabled,latest.recorded_at,latest.* FROM devices d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dd1.* FROM device_data dd1 JOIN (SELECT deveui,MAX(recorded_at) AS max_time FROM device_data GROUP BY deveui) latest ON dd1.deveui = latest.deveui AND dd1.recorded_at = latest.max_time) latest ON latest.deveui = d.deveui WHERE d.irrigation_zone_id=1 AND d.user_id=1 AND d.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.created_at ASC

SELECT d.deveui, d.type_id, CASE WHEN d.irrigation_zone_id = ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM devices d WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND (d.irrigation_zone_id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weather_station_zones w WHERE w.deveui = d.deveui AND w.zone_id = ?)) AND (d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') OR d.rain_gauge_enabled = 1)

SELECT DISTINCT d.deveui, d.type_id FROM devices d CROSS JOIN rain_observations o ON o.deveui = d.deveui AND o.received_at >= ? AND o.received_at < ? WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((d.type_id IN ('AQUASCOPE_LORAIN','SENSECAP_S2120') AND o.status = 'accepted') OR (d.type_id = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND o.instrument_type = 'DRAGINO_LSN50' AND json_extract(o.config_json, '$.rain_gauge_enabled') = 1)) AND (o.zone_id = ? OR CASE WHEN json_valid(o.config_json) THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(o.config_json, '$.zones') j WHERE j.value = ?) ELSE 0 END)
SELECT selected_deveui FROM zone_rain_source WHERE zone_id = ?

ALTER TABLE irrigation_zones ADD COLUMN timezone TEXT DEFAULT 'UTC'
